questions.q_en: Two pipes A and B can fill a tank in 20 and 30 hours, respectively. Both pipes are opened to fill the tank, but when the tank is one-third full, a leak develops through which one-fourth of the water supplied by both pipes goes out. Find the total time (in hours) taken to fill the tank.
questions.solution_en:
Efficiency of pipe A = 1/20

Efficiency of pipe B = 1/30

Efficiency of both pipes together = 1/20 + 1/30 = 1/12

Time taken by both pipes to fill 1/3rd of the tank = (1/3)/(1/12) = 4 hours

1/4th of the water supplied got wasted = 1/12 * 1/4 = 1/48

Now the effective filling rate = 1/12 - 1/48 = 1/16

Time taken to fill remaining 2/3rd of the tank = (2/3)/(1/16) = 10 (2/3) hours

Total time = 4 + 10(2/3) = 14 (2/3) hours
questions.solution_hi:

Now the effective filling rate = 1/12 - 1/48 = 1/16

Time taken to fill remaining 2/3rd of the tank = (2/3)/(1/16) = 10 (2/3) hours

Total time = 4 + 10(2/3) = 14 (2/3) hours

questions.q_en: The least number of square tiles required to pave the ceiling of a room 525 centimetre long and 378 centimetre broad is:
questions.solution_en:
To minimize the number of square tiles, use the largest possible tile size, which is the GCD of 525 cm and 378 cm.

GCD = 21

Tile side = 21 cm.

Tiles along length = 525 / 21 = 25

Tiles along breadth = 378 / 21 = 18

Total tiles = 25 * 18 = 450

Option (d) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: A and B enter into a partnership such that 5 times of A's investment is equal to 7 times of B's investment. If the total profit is Rs. 12000, then what is the share of A?
questions.solution_en:
Let investment of A and B is 'a' and 'b' respectively.

5a = 7b

a: b = 7: 5

Ratio of investment of A and B is 7: 5 and the period of investment is same for both. Which means the ratio of profit share will be same as the ratio of investment.

Ratio of profit share of A to B = 7: 5

Profit share of A = 12000 * (7/12)

= ₹7000

questions.q_en: In a company, the average monthly salary of a department of 40 employees is Rs. 31000. When 18 employees left the dept, the average monthly salary increased by Rs. 9000, then what is the average monthly salary of 18 employees who left the dept?
questions.solution_en:
The total monthly salary of the dept = 40 * 31000 = Rs. 1240000

When 18 employees left the dept, then total monthly salary of 22 employees = 22 * (31000 + 9000) = Rs. 880000

So, total monthly salary of 18 employees = 1240000 - 880000 = Rs. 360000

Hence, average monthly salary of 18 employees = Rs. 360000/18 = Rs. 20000

questions.q_en: In a high-tech 80 km circuit challenge on a circular loop track of 1200 meters, Vehicle A completes one lap in 300 seconds, while Vehicle B completes it in 360 seconds. If both start the race together, after how many seconds will Vehicle A cross paths with Vehicle B for the last time before the race concludes?
questions.solution_en:
Time taken by vehicle A to complete 80 km or 80000 m = (300/1200) x 80000 = 20000 sec

So, the required answer will be less than 20000 sec.

Speed of vehicle A = 1200/300 = 4 m/sec

Speed of vehicle B = 1200/360 = 10/3 m/sec

Relative speed = 4 - (10/3) = 2/3 m/sec

Time taken by them to meet first time at the track anywhere = 1200/ (2/3) = 1800 sec

So, the required answer will be the multiple of 1800 that is close to 20000, and that is 19800.

Therefore, after 19800 sec or 5.5 hours from the start car A meet car B for the last time.

questions.q_en: A, B, and C can complete a job in 8, 12, and 24 days individually. A, B and C respectively work on alternate days starting with A. How many days will it take in all?
questions.solution_en:
Let the total work be LCM (8, 12, 24) = 24 units.

Efficiency A = 3, B = 2, C = 1 unit/day.

Work in one 3-day cycle = 3 + 2 + 1 = 6 units.

Cycles needed = 24 / 6 = 4 cycles.

Total days = 4 cycles X 3 days/cycle = 12 days.

questions.q_en: 'A' speaks the truth 7 out of 19 times and 'B' speaks the truth 9 out of 25 times. What is the probability that they contradict each other in stating the same fact?
questions.solution_en:
Probability of A tell a lie = 1 - 7/19 = 12/19

Probability of B tell a lie = 1 - 9/25 = 16/25

Hence, the required probability =7/19 * 16/25 + 12/19 * 9/25

= 112/475 + 108/475

= 220/475

= 44/95
